review.datadog.faq.a1: Datadog charges per host/month for infrastructure and APM, per GB for logs, and has various add-ons. Costs can add up quickly — always estimate carefully before committing. The free tier is good for evaluation.
review.datadog.faq.q2: Is Datadog good for traditional network monitoring?
review.datadog.faq.a2: Datadog's NPM is excellent for modern cloud/container environments but less deep than traditional NMS tools like SolarWinds or PRTG for legacy infrastructure with SNMP polling, device configuration, etc.
review.datadog.faq.q3: Do I need the agent installed everywhere?
review.datadog.faq.a3: For full functionality, yes. The Datadog Agent collects metrics, traces, and logs. Agentless monitoring is available for some cloud services via API integrations.
